text: Read-only MCP for everyone: read the graph, at most move an idea to review
description: A restricted MCP mode anyone can be given: all read tools (search, context, prioritized ideas, phases), and as its only write, moving an idea to review with a status comment (claiming "I think this is done, here is the evidence"). No creating, deleting, linking, or value changes. Likely a server flag (e.g. AIMPARENCY_MCP_MODE=read-only) that registers only the allowed tools, plus a backend guard so the restriction does not depend on the client.
